description: Source code for the HpackStringCollector class used in HTTP/2 test tools, including methods for collecting and verifying HPACK string data, operator overloads, and internal state management.

classes.name: HpackStringCollector
classes.description: A class for collecting and verifying HPACK-encoded strings in HTTP/2 testing.

methods.name: HpackStringCollector
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the collector to a clear state.

methods.name: HpackStringCollector
methods.description: Parameterized constructor initializing with a string and Huffman encoding flag.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Resets the collector to its initial state.

methods.name: IsClear
methods.description: Checks if the collector is in a clear state.

methods.name: IsInProgress
methods.description: Checks if string collection is in progress.

methods.name: HasEnded
methods.description: Checks if string collection has ended.

methods.name: OnStringStart
methods.description: Marks the start of a string collection with Huffman flag and length.

methods.name: OnStringData
methods.description: Appends data to the collector's string buffer.

methods.name: OnStringEnd
methods.description: Marks the end of string collection.

methods.name: Collected
methods.description: Verifies collected string data against expected values.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the collector's current state.
